title: symphyotrichum dumosum var. gracilipes
intro: Symphyotrichum dumosum var. gracilipes, commonly known as New England aster, is a perennial plant species in the sunflower family (Asteraceae). This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Symphyotrichum dumosum var. gracilipes include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties, which can aid in wound healing, reduce fever, and alleviate respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to relax muscles, reduce anxiety, and promote sleep, while its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, terpenoids, and saponins.
